LESSON: SARUFI 6.4.1 VITENZI VIKUU VISAIDIZI

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.4: Sarufi 6.4.1 Vitenzi vikuu visaidizi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 6.4.1 Vitenzi vikuu visaidizi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua vitenzi vikuu na visaidizi katika matini
2. kutumia vitenzi vikuu na visaidizi ipasavyo katika matini

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua vitenzi vikuu na visaidizi katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua vitenzi vikuu na visaidizi katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutumia vitenzi vikuu na visaidizi ipasavyo katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia vitenzi vikuu na visaidizi ipasavyo katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 6.4.1 Vitenzi vikuu visaidizi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 6.4.1 Vitenzi vikuu visaidizi in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 6.4.1 Vitenzi vikuu visaidizi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 6.4.1 Vitenzi vikuu visaidizi.
4. Show that you can: kutambua vitenzi vikuu na visaidizi katika matini

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 6.4.1 Vitenzi vikuu visaidizi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 6.4.1 Vitenzi vikuu visaidizi important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua vitenzi vikuu na visaidizi katika matini
2. kutumia vitenzi vikuu na visaidizi ipasavyo katika matini

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
